title: What is DOM?
overview: DOM (Document Object Model) is a programming interface that represents an HTML document as a tree of objects. JavaScript can use DOM to read, modify, and interact with web pages.

title: Selecting DOM Elements
overview: JavaScript provides different methods to select HTML elements from the DOM. These elements can then be modified using JavaScript.

title: Changing DOM Content
overview: JavaScript can modify the text and content of HTML elements dynamically using DOM properties.

title: Changing Styles Using DOM
overview: JavaScript can modify the styles of HTML elements by accessing their style properties through the DOM.

title: DOM Events
overview: DOM events allow JavaScript to respond to user actions like clicks, typing, mouse movements, and other interactions.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned what DOM is, how JavaScript interacts with HTML elements, selecting elements, changing content, updating styles, and handling events.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ DOM represents HTML as objects.
✔ JavaScript can modify webpage content.
